episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the concept of 'Separation Season,' a strategy for real estate agents to maintain momentum during slow periods by focusing on fundamentals and long-term planning. He emphasizes the importance of client follow-up and analyzing past transactions to replicate success. The episode provides actionable insights for agents looking to differentiate themselves in a competitive market.
